attrs.value: We have no choice but to advance. If we retreat now, Durand will have time to regain his power and to escape. We will never be free of him unless we strike.
We'll never be able to breach these defenses. There are simply too many, far more than our scouts had estimated.
Then leave. I do not fear death in the service of my nation.
Don't be too hasty guys. Look who I found lurking outside our base. It's my old buddy!
I wasn't lurking. I came here to help. There is a route. A mountain pass across the lake. It's poorly defended. The terrain there won't support the heavier units. I can take you there.
I don't trust him. I say we ice this greaseball.
Take it easy Argent. I think he's really here to help.
He has to be stopped. I don't... I don't think I can do it alone. I want you to help me. My father died in those strikes on Akadian bases that Durand ordered. I have to help put him to rest.
You see madness and betrayal behind his eyes, but I see the devotion of a man consumed by his cause. Our vengeance will be his vengeance.
We cannot fail here, Tucker. This battle means too much to our people. If you or Argent do not feel up to the challenge that faces us, I cannot allow you to join us.
We're all ready. Durand has to be stopped.
I dunno. I AM pretty tired.
It is settled then. At dawn, we take Durand's fortress. Prepare yourselves.
Oooooh. So close. And yet, so very far away. Maybe next time, team.
